brand.name: Paddle Board Overstock
brand.alternateName: Paddle Board Overstock — Inflatable SUP Overstock & Clearance
brand.slogan: Discount Inflatable SUP Boards — Overstock, Clearance & Small-Business Wholesale
brand.description: Paddle Board Overstock, operated by Weihai Dongjilian Co., Ltd., is an international supplier of discounted inflatable stand-up paddle boards (SUPs), specializing in surplus production inventory and factory clearance batches. Our overstock inventory comes from surplus production batches of our own Weihai manufacturing operations and selected excess inventory sourced from other production partners. Complete paddle board packages (board, pump, paddle, leash, backpack), accessories, and mixed-model small-business wholesale ship worldwide at up to 60% off retail, with secure Stripe & PayPal checkout.

inventory.sourceStatement: Our overstock inventory comes from a combination of surplus production batches from our own manufacturing operations and selected excess inventory sourced from other production partners.
inventory._mixedModelNote: 允许同一张订单混采不同型号（Mixed Model Wholesale），面向 5-20 块小批量采购的小型零售商。
inventory.batchInspection: Every batch is checked for product condition and availability before being offered for sale.

shipping.expressFit: 1-3 boards, sample orders, individual buyers, urgent restocking
shipping.seaFreightFit: 5-20 boards, small retailers, rental operators, bulk wholesale

quality.defectFreeRateNote: Based on outgoing shipment inspection over the trailing 12-month period
